tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /sprul sku legs pa lung bstan pa:

e ma ho: yang zab mkha' 'gro snying thig 'di: kun la ma spel nyams su longs: spel drags snod min dam sel byed: de yi sku tshe tshad mi phyin: brgyud 'dzin nyer gcig lnga bshad pa: gcig gis tshul dang mthun par spel: shel dkar skye ba bcu bdun pa: sham po gangs kyi shar lho phyogs: rigs ldan chu khams stag lo pa: sbas tshul 'khor ba'i cha 'dzin cing : skye ba rgyun khyer don blo ldan: zhen pa chung zhing ngang rgyud ring : snying sdar tshe ring longs spyod chung : snying tig thabs kyi cha yin pas: brla g.yas pa yi nang logs la: sha sme mkha' 'gro'i spyan 'dra yod: skyes bu dam ldan legs pa zhes: zab mo chos kyi bstan pa spel: skye mtha'i byang sems min re kan: 'di yis 'gro don spel ba yong : sa la gnas pa'i byang sems kyis: rgya gar rgya nag sing ga dang : bod kyi yul du 'phel bar 'gyur: gzhan yang bshes gnyen dam pa dang : lam sgom theg chen rigs rnams mos: phal pa'i 'gro ba mos 'dud nyung : 'di dang 'phrad tshad don chen 'gyur: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: PAGE - PAGE 176 -
